description: Source code for a Jira importer module that reads Jira XML data, processes it into board and card structures, and exports a block archive. Contains functions for parsing XML, creating properties, and mapping Jira items to visual blocks.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function to read input XML, parse it, convert Jira items into board and block structures, and write output archive.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts Jira items array into boards and blocks for visualization.

methods.name: buildCardPropertyFromValues
methods.description: Creates a property template with options based on unique values from Jira items.

methods.name: setSelectProperty
methods.description: Assigns a select property value to a card based on property options.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value directly on a card.

methods.name: optionForPropertyValue
methods.description: Finds the matching property option for a given value.
